text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 vaccines can cause some mild, temporary side effects, but these are not the same as COVID-19 symptoms. Common side effects include pain or swelling at the injection site, fatigue, fever, headache, muscle aches, chills, and joint pain. These reactions typically resolve within a day or two. Symptoms of COVID-19 include fever, cough, shortness of breath, loss of taste or smell, and fatigue. If you experience severe symptoms such as trouble breathing, persistent chest pain, or confusion after vaccination, seek immediate medical attention.
